subject.title: feat: add Podman agent sandbox backend

question: Should the configured `docker` identity and `allowBackends: ["docker"]` policy be allowed to execute through Podman automatically when the Docker CLI is absent?
rationale: That fallback changes the actual isolation engine under existing configuration and Codex external-sandbox delegation, so tests cannot determine the intended authorization contract.

options.title: Require Explicit Podman
options.body: Keep `backend: "docker"` Docker-only and require `backend: "podman"` plus `allowBackends: ["podman"]` for Podman execution.

options.title: Approve Docker Fallback
options.body: Intentionally authorize Podman under the Docker policy identity, with explicit upgrade/security documentation and final-head proof for both engines.

recommendation.title: Require Explicit Podman
recommendation.body: Keep `backend: "docker"` Docker-only and require `backend: "podman"` plus `allowBackends: ["podman"]` for Podman execution.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged history most strongly connects steipete to the sandbox security and backend contract.
